name: Seireitei Outer Wall & Four Gates
jp: 瀞霊廷外壁 / 四大瀞霊門
summary: The fortified threshold between Rukongai and the Shinigami capital.
architecture: Massive Sekkiseki slabs form the Seireiheki, with four guarded entrances arranged to the north, east, south and west. A spherical barrier extends the defensive logic beyond the wall.
purpose: Regulates entry into Seireitei and limits unauthorized spiritual approach.
residents: Jidanbō Ikkanzaka — western gatekeeper
Higonyūdō — southern gatekeeper
Danzōmaru — northern gatekeeper
Kaiwan — eastern gatekeeper
events: Ichigo and his companions reach the western White Road Gate during the Soul Society arc.
Jidanbō lifts the gate after his defeat, but Gin Ichimaru intervenes and blocks the entry.
trivia: Each enormous gate has a smaller built-in door for ordinary passage.
details: Massive Sekkiseki slabs form the Seireiheki, with four guarded entrances arranged to the north, east, south and west. A spherical barrier extends the defensive logic beyond the wall. Regulates entry into Seireitei and limits unauthorized spiritual approach.

images.title: Outer Pure Soul Gate
images.caption: Massive Sekkiseki portal and stone ramparts guarding the threshold between Rukongai and the capital.

images.title: Ceremonial Threshold Passage
images.caption: Parting double doors of the inner barrier revealing the rising central pagoda towers beyond.

images.title: Perimeter Wall & Floating Citadel
images.caption: Broad aerial perspective of the circular Sekkiseki fortification shielding the inner citadel above clouds.

name: Sōkyoku Hill
summary: A rocky execution mesa overlooking the centre of Seireitei.
architecture: The hill rises as a sheer-sided mesa, reached by a long bridge from Senzaikyū and a zigzag stair cut into the rock. A cave below opens into a large training chamber.
purpose: Hosts the execution of Shinigami convicted of severe offences and contains a former Bankai training ground.
residents: Rukia Kuchiki — condemned prisoner
Ichigo Kurosaki — rescuer and combatant
Jūshirō Ukitake and Shunsui Kyōraku — captains who intervene
events: Rukia’s execution ceremony is held at the hill and Ichigo stops the Sōkyoku.
Ichigo and Byakuya’s decisive Soul Society arc battle takes place at the site.
trivia: The underground chamber was later used by Ichigo and Renji for Bankai training.
details: The hill rises as a sheer-sided mesa, reached by a long bridge from Senzaikyū and a zigzag stair cut into the rock. A cave below opens into a large training chamber. Hosts the execution of Shinigami convicted of severe offences and contains a former Bankai training ground.

images.title: Execution Mesa & Sōkyoku Stand
images.caption: The windswept plateau overlooking Seireitei where the legendary execution halberd is anchored.

images.title: Central Prominence
images.caption: The distinctive rocky rise at the heart of Seireitei visible above the rooftops.

images.title: Horizon of the High Sanctuary
images.caption: Distant view of the central citadel spires as seen across the high plateaus of the Central Rise.

name: Senzaikyū / Tower of Penitence
summary: The white prison tower linked to the Sōkyoku Hill by a ceremonial bridge.
architecture: A tall white tower at Seireitei’s centre contains the Sekkiseki-lined Shishinrō, whose mineral walls suppress spiritual power and disrupt spiritual sensing.
purpose: Holds condemned criminals before transfer to Sōkyoku Hill for execution under Central 46 authority.
residents: Rukia Kuchiki — held in the Shishinrō
Other unnamed Shinigami condemned to Sōkyoku execution
events: Rukia’s sentence and revised execution date are announced while she is confined here.
The procession from the Shishinrō across the bridge begins the execution sequence interrupted by Ichigo.
trivia: The descriptive fan label ‘Tower of Penitence’ sits alongside translations such as ‘Palace of Penitence’.
details: A tall white tower at Seireitei’s centre contains the Sekkiseki-lined Shishinrō, whose mineral walls suppress spiritual power and disrupt spiritual sensing. Holds condemned criminals before transfer to Sōkyoku Hill for execution under Central 46 authority.

images.title: Tower of Penitence & Causeway
images.caption: The isolated white stone tower rising out of the mist, connected solely by a narrow guarded bridge.

images.title: Bridge Connection to Sōkyoku
images.caption: Ceremonial bridge spanning the chasm from Senzaikyū toward the execution grounds.

images.title: Skyway Approach
images.caption: Elevated balustrades and lantern columns running toward the central rise and restricted zones.

name: Shin’ō Academy
summary: Soul Society’s principal school for spiritually gifted souls entering service.
architecture: A large multi-level complex with an open courtyard, classrooms, dormitories and dedicated spaces for swordsmanship, hand-to-hand combat, movement arts and Kidō.
purpose: A standard six-year course prepares students for the Gotei 13, Kidō Corps or Onmitsukidō through Reiatsu control, Hakuda, Hōhō, Kidō, Zanjutsu and Soul Burial.
residents: Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto — founder and former grandmaster
Renji Abarai, Rukia Kuchiki, Momo Hinamori and Izuru Kira — notable students
Shunsui Kyōraku and Jūshirō Ukitake — notable graduates
events: Renji and Rukia’s academy years shape their early Soul Society history.
An academy practical exercise involving Momo, Renji and Kira is interrupted by enormous Hollows.
trivia: The formal name means Spiritual Arts Academy; the older ‘Shinigami Academy’ label remains widely used.
details: A large multi-level complex with an open courtyard, classrooms, dormitories and dedicated spaces for swordsmanship, hand-to-hand combat, movement arts and Kidō. A standard six-year course prepares students for the Gotei 13, Kidō Corps or Onmitsukidō through Reiatsu control, Hakuda, Hōhō, Kidō, Zanjutsu and Soul Burial.

images.caption: Spiritual Arts Academy grounds with cherry blossom trees and open-air Zanjutsu training pavilions.

images.title: Grand Archival Hall
images.caption: The Academy archives housing ancient Kidō scrolls, tactical maps, and soul burial records.

images.title: Academic Faculty Complex
images.caption: Multi-tiered administrative pagodas and lecture quarters for instructors and senior instructors.

name: 1st Division Barracks
jp: 一番隊舎 / 隊首会議室
summary: The First Division headquarters and formal meeting place of the Gotei 13 captains.
architecture: A barracks compound of offices and living quarters organised around the captains’ assembly hall, a separate lieutenants’ room and the Captain-Commander’s office.
purpose: Houses First Division administration and hosts formal councils about division affairs and threats to Soul Society.
residents: Shunsui Kyōraku — Captain-Commander and First Division captain
Nanao Ise and Genshirō Okikiba — co-lieutenants
Genryūsai Yamamoto — former Captain-Commander
events: The hall hosts the Gotei 13’s formal captains’ council.
After Yamamoto’s death, his broken Ryūjin Jakka is returned to the First Division Barracks.
trivia: A separate room is used for lieutenants’ meetings, keeping the command structure legible even in miniature.
details: A barracks compound of offices and living quarters organised around the captains’ assembly hall, a separate lieutenants’ room and the Captain-Commander’s office. Houses First Division administration and hosts formal councils about division affairs and threats to Soul Society.

images.title: 1st Division Headquarters Compound
images.caption: The majestic multi-tiered command citadel flying the official First Division standard.

images.title: Captains' Council Chamber
images.caption: The grand assembly hall where all 13 Division Captains convene for emergency war councils.

images.title: Grand Processional Axis
images.caption: Ceremonial walkway lined with blue division banners leading directly to the First Division estate.

name: 4th Division Relief Station
summary: The Gotei 13’s principal emergency-care and recovery facility.
architecture: A traditional division-barracks compound combines offices and living quarters with wards, treatment rooms, beds, stretchers and numbered inpatient rooms.
purpose: Fourth Division relief teams provide battlefield first aid, transport, healing Kidō, surgery, Reiatsu care and inpatient support.
residents: Retsu Unohana — former Fourth Division captain
Isane Kotetsu — later captain
Hanatarō Yamada — officer and relief-team leader
Fourth Division nurses and healers
events: After the first Wandenreich invasion, the station receives a surge of wounded Shinigami.
Rukia and Renji recover there after critical surgery and Reiatsu treatment.
trivia: The station’s nurses are visually distinguished by pink Shihakushō and nurse-style hats.
details: A traditional division-barracks compound combines offices and living quarters with wards, treatment rooms, beds, stretchers and numbered inpatient rooms. Fourth Division relief teams provide battlefield first aid, transport, healing Kidō, surgery, Reiatsu care and inpatient support.

images.title: 4th Division Healing Wards
images.caption: Tranquil recovery courtyard with drying medicinal herbs, tatami wards, and healing Kidō stations.

images.title: Medical Records & Herbal Archive
images.caption: Dispensary library where historical healing techniques, spiritual anatomy records, and antidotes are cataloged.

images.title: Medical Quarter Boundary
images.caption: Traditional wooden barracks corridors connecting inpatient pavilions to the central command path.

name: Reiōkyū (Soul King Palace)
summary: The celestial royal domain floating above Soul Society, housing the Soul King and the five palaces of Squad Zero.
architecture: Five circular floating disc cities (Kirinden, Gatonden, Hōōden, Senjumaru Palace, and Hyōsube Sanctuary) orbit the central Great Soul King Palace above a sea of spiritual clouds and cascading waterfalls.
purpose: Maintains the cosmic equilibrium of the Three Realms (Human World, Soul Society, and Hueco Mundo) through the spiritual anchor of the Soul King, guarded exclusively by the Royal Guard.
residents: Reiō — The Soul King and linchpin of existence
Ichibē Hyōsube — Monk Who Calls the Real Name (Leader of Squad Zero)
Ōetsu Nimaiya — Sword God & creator of all Zanpakutō and Asauchi
Tenjirō Kirinji — Hot Spring Demon & healing pioneer
Kirio Hikifune — Ruler of Grain & creator of artificial souls
Senjumaru Shutara — Great Weave Guard & royal weaver
events: Following the first Quincy assault on Seireitei, Squad Zero arrives via the Tenchūren pillar palanquin to bring Ichigo, Rukia, Renji, and Byakuya to the Royal Realm for divine recovery.
Ichigo learns his Quincy heritage at the Hōōden forge, discovering the truth of Old Man Zangetsu and forging his true dual blades.
Yhwach and his Schutzstaffel invade the palace, leading to the climactic clash where Senjumaru Shutara unleashes her universe-shaking Bankai Shatshu Gagara Garami.
trivia: The five members of the Royal Guard possess combined combat capability exceeding that of the entire Gotei 13's thirteen divisions combined.
details: The ultimate spiritual realm floating in a separate dimensional stratosphere above Seireitei, protected by 72 layered spiritual barriers. Only those whose bones have been infused with the Ōken (Royal Key) may pass without triggering automatic vaporization.

images.title: The Five Palaces of Squad Zero
images.caption: Sacred disc cities orbiting the Great Soul King Palace above heavenly clouds and cascading spiritual waterfalls.

images.title: High Sacred Sanctuary
images.caption: The central elevated palace overlooking the infinite spiritual horizon of Soul Society.

images.title: View Down to Seireitei
images.caption: The vast circular capital of Seireitei far below the 72 layered spiritual barriers.

name: 6th Division Barracks & Kuchiki Manor
summary: Headquarters of the internal-enforcement Sixth Division and ancestral sakura gardens of the noble Kuchiki Clan.
architecture: Traditional aristocratic wooden compounds framed by walled koi ponds, stone lanterns, and centuries-old cherry blossom groves lining the Gotei promenade.
purpose: Enforces Gotei 13 internal discipline, safeguards noble decrees, and maintains detention quarters alongside the Kuchiki estate.
residents: Byakuya Kuchiki — 28th Head of the Kuchiki Clan & 6th Division Captain
Renji Abarai — 6th Division Lieutenant
Ginrei Kuchiki — former Captain and clan elder
events: Renji Abarai attains his resolve to surpass Byakuya within the quiet sakura courtyards before the Ryōka crisis.
The Sixth Division deploys along the central promenade and Sōkyoku perimeter to uphold Rukia Kuchiki’s custody decree.
trivia: Byakuya Kuchiki’s personal scarves and ancestral crest (Ginpakukazahana) rank among the most valuable aristocratic artifacts in Seireitei.
details: Bridges Gotei military oversight and Great Noble governance, pairing austere judicial administration with serene cherry-blossom courtyards along the Seireitei promenade.

images.title: Sakura Promenade & Koi Quarter
images.caption: Ceremonial thoroughfare and lantern-lit courtyards adjoining the Sixth Division and Kuchiki estate.

images.title: 6th Division Administrative Complex
images.caption: Multi-tiered dark timber and cobalt tile pavilions housing internal discipline archives and training halls.

images.title: Inner Gotei District Panorama
images.caption: Aerial perspective across the noble estates and Gotei division barracks within the inner Sekkiseki ring.

name: Central 46 Judicial Compound
jp: 中央四十六室 / 清浄塔居林
summary: The supreme legislative and judicial tribunal governing all laws, executions, and decrees of Soul Society.
architecture: Situated within Seijōtōkyorin (Forest of Pure Living Towers), a secluded enclosure shielding the subterranean chamber where forty elders and six judges deliberate in absolute secrecy.
purpose: Issues binding verdicts on Soul Reapers, nobles, and crimes against the balance of souls—authority even the Captain-Commander cannot legally override.
residents: Forty Wise Elders & Six Judges — supreme tribunal magistrates
Nayura Kurosaki / post-war magistrate reforms under Shunsui Kyōraku
Sōsuke Aizen (usurper during Soul Society arc)
events: Sōsuke Aizen secretly assassinated all forty-six magistrates inside the compound and issued forged execution directives via Kyōka Suigetsu.
Tōshirō Hitsugaya and Rangiku Matsumoto uncovered the sealed bodies, exposing Aizen’s rebellion across Seireitei.
trivia: Only authorized officers may approach Seijōtōkyorin; until Aizen’s rebellion, the compound remained sealed even from Gotei captains during deliberations.
details: Seated at the political fulcrum of Seireitei, Central 46 rules on every sentence from Muken imprisonment to Sōkyoku execution.

images.title: Supreme Tribunal & Assembly Hall
images.caption: The austere inner assembly chamber surrounded by towering stone tiers and ceremonial blue banners.

images.title: Sealed Inner Sanctum Threshold
images.caption: Gilded barrier doors dividing the military headquarters from the high judicial district.

images.title: Codified Law & Decree Vault
images.caption: Deep archival chambers preserving centuries of Soul Society judicial statutes and sealed verdicts.
